notes: Tier 1 (direct HTTP fetch) used throughout: robots.txt checked first (no Claude-specific disallow; standard Shopify boilerplate disallows on /cart /account /checkout etc, Sitemap directive present). Fetched sitemap.xml -> sitemap-0.xml (36,855 lines, full URL list covering pages/collections/products/blog) and grepped it for the full seasonal vocabulary (Christmas/Xmas, Halloween, Diwali/Deepavali, Easter, Valentine, Thanksgiving, New Year, Holi/Rakhi/Eid/Navratri/Dussehra, Mother's/Father's Day, Black Friday, holiday/festive/festival) both under /collections/ and site-wide. Only Christmas-associated collection/page URLs exist anywhere on the site; zero matches for every other holiday term (confirmed absence, not a search-null-result guess). Also checked homepage top nav (only department-level links render in static HTML; sub-nav is client-fetched) and the 'Gifts By Occasion' collection family (housewarming/christmas/party/anniversary/birthday/thank-you/engagement-wedding/baby-shower gifts) which contains no other holiday besides Christmas. 'New Season Autumn/Winter' and 'New Season Spring/Summer' collections exist but are fashion/retail seasons, not holidays/festivals, so excluded per rules. House is a kitchenware/homewares-only Shopify (house.com.au) retailer confirmed throughout via URL. For each Christmas collection, qty taken from the SSR-rendered 'You've viewed X of X products' counter (site's own displayed total). /christmas-gift-shop excluded as a marketing/landing hero page (title 'Christmas Gift Ideas - Kitchen & Cooking Gifts', no product grid/count rendered, links only to top-level departments) per the Christmas-Landing-Page exclusion rule. Two distinct 'Christmas Decor' nodes exist at different URLs with different counts (Living>Decor>Christmas Decor = 34; Gifting>Gifts By Occasion>Christmas Gifts>Christmas Decor = 67) -- kept both since they are genuinely different underlying listings (different URL, different count), not a duplicate per the overlap rule. 'Christmas Gifts' (571 products, own real product grid, not just a hub) is kept as its own leaf row even though it also has four sub-branches, because its own count (571) far exceeds the sum of its four listed children (10+192+0+67=269), meaning it holds many products not exposed in any child sub-collection -- so it is a genuine standalone PLP in the site's own taxonomy, not a pure grouping shell; not marked is_group to avoid discarding that qty, per accuracy-over-dedup priority. 'Wreaths, Garlands & Trees' (under Christmas Gifts) was checked via direct HTTP (191KB response, no 'viewed X of Y products' text, no product markup) and independently verified via a rendered browser tab (Tier 2/3 spot-check for this one page only, used because of genuine structural ambiguity over whether the page was broken vs. genuinely empty): page loaded correctly (breadcrumb Home>Gifting>Gifts By Occasion>Christmas Gifts>Wreaths Garlands & Trees, full FAQ/about content, real category page) but the product grid area stayed on 'Loading...' indefinitely with zero follow-up network requests to any product/collection API -- consistent with the collection currently holding 0 live products (plausible given the check was done in early September, months before the Dec/Southern-Hemisphere Christmas season and well before trees/wreaths are typically restocked). Recorded as qty 0 with a manual-review flag rather than dropped, since it is a genuine, permanently-titled sub-category node in the site's taxonomy, just currently unstocked. No PDPs were crawled for bulk validation; the one browser open was solely to resolve this single ambiguity.
